title: Strange Case of Dr Jekyll and Mr Hyde
author: Robert Louis Stevenson

Hyde compensates the family via a cheque signed by Jekyll
Utterson finds Jekyll's will names Hyde as sole heir
Servant sees Hyde beat Sir Danvers Carew to death
Cane at scene traced to Jekyll
Jekyll appears rejuvenated and sociable for two months
Jekyll abruptly turns reclusive, refusing all visitors
Lanyon dies after witnessing Hyde transform into Jekyll
Lanyon leaves sealed instructions for Utterson
Utterson and Poole break into Jekyll's laboratory
Find Hyde's body in Jekyll's clothes, apparent suicide
Letters reveal the experiment separating good from evil
Hyde emerged involuntarily and killed Carew
Serum failing; Jekyll cannot reverse the transformation
Jekyll ends his account as Hyde takes over permanently
